specs.label: Audio Output Jacks
specs.value: Two (2) 3.5 mm (0.14 in.) connectors, unbalanced, 0 dBu nominal output level, 16 mW maximum, impedance 32 ohm, accepts mono or stereo phone plug or LA-430 Intelligent Ear Phone/Neck Loop Lanyard

specs.label: Programming
specs.value: Via software and USB port, Auto Seek, Jack Sense, Squelch, Auto Power, Auto Off, Stereo, Brightness, Channel Name

specs.label: Set-up Controls
specs.value: Press and hold up/down volume buttons for 5 seconds to enterchannel adjust, use up/down to select channel

specs.label: Display
specs.value: OLED - Channel designation, battery level, unit number, charging status, volume status

specs.label: LED
specs.value: Flashes when batteries are low or to indicate charging, solid when fully charged
